scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run openapi:check && turbo run lint typecheck test --output-logs=errors-only
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.openapi:generate: turbo run build --filter=@keepio/api --output-logs=errors-only >/dev/null && node apps/api/dist/openapi-export.js packages/api-client/openapi.json && npm run --silent generate -w @keepio/api-client >/dev/null && prettier --write --log-level warn packages/api-client/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated
